correctness.rationale: The Nijenhuis identity for x*y=phi(x)y cancels to phi(Nx)N(y) on both sides for every linear N; the deformed multiplication is (phi o N)(x)y. Any nonzero functional yields the same algebra isomorphism type; the map N->phi o N is surjective with q^{n(n-1)}-element fibers and whole locus q^{n^2}. Rota–Baxter weight zero is exactly N^2=0, with rank-r counts by image/kernel flag. Reconstructed the cancellation, all cardinalities and rank range. Independent enumeration over F2 for n=1,2,3 checks every 2^{n^2} matrix, full basis-pair identity, fibers and square-zero equivalence; tested n=3 has 512 Nijenhuis operators and 22 square-zero maps. These finite checks are not the arbitrary-field proof.
